## A01: Broken Access Control

_Restrictions on what authenticated users are allowed to do are not properly enforced._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] File operations respect OS permissions
- [ ] No privilege escalation without explicit sudo/admin request

## A02: Cryptographic Failures

_Sensitive data exposed due to weak or absent encryption._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] API keys stored in OS keychain or encrypted vault
- [ ] HTTPS enforced for all outbound requests

## A03: Injection

_User-supplied data sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] No shell=True in subprocess calls
- [ ] File paths validated before use

## A04: Insecure Design

_Missing or ineffective control design that cannot be fixed by correct implementation._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] STRIDE analysis completed (see STRIDE_ANALYSIS.md)
- [ ] Security reviewed as part of architecture decisions

## A05: Security Misconfiguration

_Missing appropriate security hardening across the application stack._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] Config files have restrictive permissions (600)
- [ ] No sensitive data in environment variable names that appear in logs

## A06: Vulnerable and Outdated Components

_Using components with known vulnerabilities._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] Dependency CVE scan in CI (`genesis check` or npm audit / safety / cargo audit)
- [ ] Dependabot or Renovate configured for automatic dependency updates
- [ ] No EOL runtime versions (check python.org/node.js schedule)
- [ ] Third-party components reviewed before adoption

## A07: Identification and Authentication Failures (N/A for this archetype)

_Weaknesses in authentication that allow attackers to compromise passwords or session tokens._

> Skipped: cli archetype does not have an applicable surface for this risk.

## A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures

_Code and infrastructure not protected against integrity violations._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] CI/CD pipeline requires PR review before merge to main
- [ ] Git tags signed for releases
- [ ] Dependency integrity verified (lock files committed)
- [ ] No `curl | bash` patterns in installation docs

## A09: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures

_Insufficient logging, detection, or monitoring of security events._

**Checklist:**

- [ ] Errors logged to stderr with timestamps
- [ ] Destructive operations logged before execution

## A10: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) (N/A for this archetype)

_Attacker can make the server fetch arbitrary URLs._
